description: Figure 3 (top grouping) presents a set of three pie charts showing the distribution of problem outcomes by correctness under w/ knowledge versus w/o knowledge settings for the CoT method, separated by difficulty level; there are three pies total labeled “easy,” “medium,” and “hard.” Each pie contains four slices corresponding to the legend categories shown at the right: N+K+ (teal), N−K+ (yellow), N−K− (gray), and N+K− (orange), with percentage values printed inside the slices. In the “easy” pie, the slices are approximately 40.6% (teal, N+K+), 45.9% (yellow, N−K+), 10.1% (gray, N−K−), and 3.3% (orange, N+K−). In the “medium” pie, the slices are approximately 44.6% (teal), 44.3% (yellow), 7.2% (gray), and 3.9% (orange). In the “hard” pie, the slices are approximately 20.1% (teal), 36.2% (yellow), 36.8% (gray), and 7.0% (orange). No slices appear exploded or otherwise emphasized, and the slice ordering varies by pie rather than following a single consistent descending-size arrangement.
